node.title: Acoplamiento selectivo entre sistemas
node.summary: Connect systems in stages to expose capabilities to new demands while retaining adaptation space.

relations: Selective coupling offers a way to discuss the transition between focused intervention and organizational absorption without treating immediate full integration as the default.
El parentesco no demuestra que los casos Tiger Team hayan sido diseñados como pruebas del régimen de Part IV.
Selective coupling becomes an actionable design question only when authority, escalation, operating limits and exit conditions are explicit at the interface.
El contrato no valida la predicción de saltos ni autoriza someter una operación crítica a presión experimental.
A possible operational test is whether selective decoupling preserves room for exploration while reducing coordination that blocks action across the network.
Hipótesis propuesta. La fricción no es siempre aprendizaje ni un menor acoplamiento mejora cualquier sistema.
